itens.titulo: Tesla Stocks Rise 3.7% Before a $7.8 Billion Capex Test
itens.descricao: Tesla Stocks Rise 3.7% Before a $7.8 Billion Capex Test Yahoo Finance
trechos: Electric-vehicle and AI developer Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) climbed to $387.475, up 3.68% from the previous close, around 10:00 a.m.
ET on October 21 as investors awaited quarterly results.
Tesla's company-compiled analyst consensus projects $28.34 billion in third-quarter revenue alongside $7.77 billion in capital spending.
GuruFocus has detected 6 Warning Signs with TSLA.
Analysts expect a 17.9% gross margin but just a 2.5% operating margin, leaving little revenue flowing through to operating profit.
They also forecast $3.27 billion in operating cash flow and negative $4.51 billion in free cash flow.
The valuation leaves limited room for disappointment: shares trade 14.9% above the $337.24 GF Value estimate, suggesting investors already expect more than modest operating profitability.

trechos: AI-chip designer Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) rose to $544.21, up approximately 1.77% at 10:40 a.m.
According to TipRanks' The Fly, the firm raised its target to $620 from $550.
That puts roughly 13.9% potential upside on the table.
GuruFocus has detected 4 Warning Signs with AMD.
AMD reported second-quarter Data Center revenue of $6.7 billion, up 107% from a year earlier, as demand for EPYC processors and Instinct graphics chips accelerated.
Its Helios racks, MI400 accelerators, sixth-generation EPYC processors and updated ROCm software broaden the push into AI infrastructure.
The valuation picture demands discipline: shares trade 85.4% above the $293.54 GF Value estimate, suggesting substantial growth expectations are already baked in.

itens.titulo: Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) reports Q3 2026 revenue in line with expectations
itens.descricao: Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) reports Q3 2026 revenue in line with expectations Yahoo Finance
trechos: Electric vehicle pioneer Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) met Wall Street's revenue expectations in Q3 2026, but sales were flat year on year at $28.05 billion.
Its non-GAAP profit of $0.48 per share was 6.3% above analysts' consensus estimates.
The company's revenue base of $46.85 billion five years ago has more than doubled to $103.6 billion in the last year, translating into an incredible 17.2% annualized growth rate.
Over the same period, Tesla's automotive peers Rivian, General Motors, and Ford put up annualized growth rates of 70.4%, 7.4%, and 6.8%, respectively.
Tesla's recent performance shows its demand has slowed significantly as its annualized revenue growth of 3.3% over the last two years was well below its five-year trend.
This quarter, Tesla's $28.05 billion of revenue was flat year on year and in line with Wall Street's estimates.
Automotive: act one Revenue: the race for dominance Tesla is primarily an automobile manufacturer today and generates 72.4% of its revenue through the sale and leasing of EVs.
The Model 3 and Model Y (released in 2017 and 2019) are the headliners of this story, and we'll dive into their impacts below.

itens.descricao: Dólar hoje sobe a R$ 5,02, após nova pesquisa da Quaest e na contramão do exterior InfoMoney
trechos: O dólar à vista encerrou com alta de 0,18%, a R$5,0272.
No ano, a divisa passou a acumular baixa de 8,41%.
Às 17h15, o dólar futuro para novembro DOLX26 — o mais negociado no Brasil — cedia 0,02% na B3, aos R$5,0345.
Dólar comercial - Compra: R$ 5,027 - Venda: R$ 5,027 O que aconteceu com o dólar hoje?
O levantamento mostra o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) com 45% das intenções de voto em um eventual segundo turno, ante 44% do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).
Em relação à pesquisa anterior, divulgada em 14 de outubro, Flávio oscilou um ponto para baixo, caindo de 46%, enquanto Lula manteve os 44%.
Continua depois da publicidade Nesta rodada, a rejeição de Lula caiu de 53% para 47%, a maior oscilação entre pesquisas desde o início das eleições deste ano.
Flávio também oscilou para baixo, dentro da margem de erro, saindo de 54% para 52%.

itens.titulo: Q3 Earnings Beats for Meta, Tesla, IBM and T.I.
itens.descricao: Q3 Earnings Beats for Meta, Tesla, IBM and T.I. Yahoo Finance
trechos: Mag 7 companies are now being heard from in Q3 earnings season.
Earnings of $3.83 per share surpassed the $3.45 analysts were looking for, on revenues of $64.6 billion in the quarter, its highest ever, and up +26% year over year.

Earnings were still well off the pace set in the year-ago quarter, and that's because Meta was hit with a $10 billion charge (of an $18 billion settlement overall) in a multi-state deal regarding social media addiction in young people.
Revenue guidance was increased to a $73-76 billion range for the current quarter, as the company also projects between $135-145 billion in additional capex spending on AI infrastructure.
Finally, the company is rewarding shareholders with a 2-for-1 stock split.
META stock is up +3.9% on the news in late trading, adding to its slim +5.67% gains year to date.

Tesla TSLA also outperformed the Zacks consensus on earnings and revenues, with $0.48 per share coming in 3 cents higher than estimates on revenues of $28.05 billion, beating the $27.78 billion estimate.
Auto Gross Margins (minus EV credits) were up +18.1%, better than analysts had projected.

itens.titulo: Meta Platforms (META) Tops Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
itens.descricao: Meta Platforms (META) Tops Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates Yahoo Finance
trechos: Meta Platforms (META) came out with quarterly earnings of $7.4 per share, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $6.52 per share.
This compares to earnings of $7.25 per share a year ago.
This quarterly report represents an earnings surprise of +13.50%.
A quarter ago, it was expected that this social media company would post earnings of $7.1 per share when it actually produced earnings of $6.18, delivering a surprise of -12.96%.
Meta Platforms, which belongs to the Zacks Internet - Software industry, posted revenues of $64.6 billion for the quarter ended September 2026, surpassing the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 1.88%.
This compares to year-ago revenues of $51.24 billion.
Meta Platforms shares have added about 5.2% since the beginning of the year versus the S&P 500's gain of 12.7%.
While the magnitude and direction of estimate revisions could change following the company's just-released earnings report, the current status translates into a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) for the stock.

itens.titulo: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Rises Higher Than Market: Key Facts
itens.descricao: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Rises Higher Than Market: Key Facts Yahoo Finance
trechos: Marvell Technology (MRVL) closed the most recent trading day at $244.67, moving +1.77% from the previous trading session.
This move outpaced the S&P 500's daily gain of 0.58%.
On the other hand, the Dow registered a gain of 0.69%, and the technology-centric Nasdaq increased by 1.05%.
The chipmaker's stock has dropped by 8.36% in the past month, falling short of the Computer and Technology sector's loss of 2.67% and the S&P 500's gain of 0.97%.
The company is predicted to post an EPS of $1.1, indicating a 44.74% growth compared to the equivalent quarter last year.
Simultaneously, our latest consensus estimate expects the revenue to be $3.16 billion, showing a 52.17% escalation compared to the year-ago quarter.

For the full year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates are projecting earnings of $4.21 per share and revenue of $12.05 billion, which would represent changes of +48.24% and +47.01%, respectively, from the prior year.

The Zacks Rank system, which ranges from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), has an impressive outside-audited track record of outperformance, with #1 stocks generating an average annual return of +25% since 1988.
